summary: All 20 route targets and the finite-mainline/mature-extension documentary scope are supported. One unresolved navigation instruction restricts rereading links to section footers, whereas linked lessons place the needed earlier-step links in their body.

applicability.reason: This is a guide to existing material and operation/navigation entries. It contains no stand-alone technical mechanism, formula, measured result, original code fence, or model capability score. Transformer/Dense/MoE and other method names are route labels, and 'sixteen-grid' identifies the actual 7.19 example. The actual navigation assertions are retained and checked as repository software/documentation contracts; they are not removed for schema convenience.

read_scope.current_guide: Whole course/README.md, including necessary R.1 context; R.2 frozen raw bytes are the formal section source.
read_scope.target_material: Original chapter introductions/headings for 1–4, 8–10, 12–20, A and B; linked 7.11/7.17/7.18/7.19, 8.14–8.16, 10.1, 12.1, 14.7, A.2, A.8, B.1; 19.1/19.4/19.12 and 20.1 for scope. Target files/Notebook identity fields and original SHA-256 copies are retained in the execution manifest.
read_scope.original_contracts: Actual outline.md, rewrite-contract.md and lesson-contract.json; build_course and export_course AST-listed original contracts. reading_time.py load_routes/render_page were inspected only to determine that the last augmentation does not move prerequisite links; no time measurements or estimates were reviewed or changed.
read_scope.excluded: No old reader or technical report bodies, author result-summary notes, TRAINING/DATA/worklogs, full training, GPU work, training-data or weight downloads, mature-model inference, engineering, publication or reading-time review.

scope_verification.details: The section's local-independent-example/shared-final-project wording matches original outline initial paragraphs and rewrite-contract 保留內容與連結. Chapter 19 introductions and 19.1/19.12 explicitly present the finite new project as planned and unaccepted; chapter 20 introductions and 20.1 explicitly inherit upstream weights. R.2 asks which route to read and does not claim completion of the planned abilities.
scope_verification.unverified: No new model ability, quantitative result, runtime or remote published-site behavior is certified by this review.

factual_accuracy.details: Actual question-route targets and content labels match, but the final footer-only backread direction is contradicted by two of the guide's own linked lessons and the original generator's behavior.

numeric_verification.details: No measured quantity, numerical mechanism or calculation is asserted in R.2. Chapter numbers and the 'sixteen-grid example' are navigation labels verified against their existing source; counts in this report are only independent inventory results.

figure_consistency.details: Raw R.2 contains no Markdown image, SVG reference, img or svg element. The question/starting-point table is text navigation and requires no imagined spatial data flow. No figure render or browser visual inspection is claimed.

source_verification.details: Personally checked raw original repository contracts and actual target materials, then byte/SHA-compared permanent copies. Executed original selected link-transform AST code and a separate bounded source-position check. External papers are not needed for this section's repository navigation assertions; no paper-title or source index is used to establish a technical concept.

limitations.details: Support is limited to existing repository source links, generated target mappings, actual target Notebook entries and the documented planned/inherited scope. Local examples do not prove a completed shared core; original chapter 19 design goals and chapter 20 inherited capability remain distinct. No training or inference was used to fill any capability or score.
